goals.label: Grow my email list
goals.description: Collect email addresses for your newsletter or offers.

outcome.requirement: Use a form with a required email field before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts submitted forms with an email address. Subscription and confirmation are managed by your email service and are not measured here.

goals.label: Grow my SMS list
goals.description: Collect phone numbers for text messages.

outcome.requirement: Use a form with a required phone field before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts submitted forms with a phone number. Subscription and confirmation are managed by your SMS service and are not measured here.

goals.label: Increase basket value
goals.description: Suggest useful extras while shoppers fill their cart.

outcome.requirement: Use product recommendations with Add to cart before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts campaign appearances with at least one WooCommerce-confirmed addition. Product clicks and purchases are separate.

goals.label: Bring shoppers back to their cart
goals.description: Bring shoppers with a full cart back to checkout.

outcome.requirement: Use a design whose button links to the cart before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts clicks back to the cart. Completed orders and recovered revenue are not measured.

goals.audience_requirement: Required for this Goal: the visitor’s cart contains items. Every audience group must also meet this requirement.

goals.label: Promote an offer or content
goals.description: Send visitors to a sale, an offer or a useful page.

outcome.requirement: Use a design whose button links to your offer or content before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts clicks to your linked offer or content. Purchases and bookings after that click are not measured.

goals.label: Show a message
goals.description: Tell visitors something, like free shipping or opening hours.

outcome.requirement: Shows a message. Remove the form and any counted button, or choose Promote an offer.
outcome.measurement: Counts appearances only. A message has nothing to click or submit, so it has no conversion rate.

goals.label: Deliver a lead magnet
goals.description: Send a guide, file or checklist in exchange for an email.

outcome.requirement: Use a form with a required email field and connect a lead magnet email destination before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts lead magnet emails accepted by the site’s mail service. Inbox arrival and file downloads are not measured. Resends can count again.

goals.label: Collect enquiries
goals.description: Take questions and quote requests from visitors.

outcome.requirement: Use an enquiry form with an email or phone field before publishing.
outcome.measurement: Counts enquiries submitted here. Replies, bookings and completed work in another service are not measured.

goals.label: Help visitors find a match
goals.description: Ask a few questions and suggest the right product or page.

outcome.requirement: Use a campaign with a Result screen and questions that lead to it.
outcome.measurement: Counts quiz results shown. Product clicks and purchases are separate.
